question.ask: How many referrals are still New?
question.whyItMatters: The coordinator contacts each new referral within one business day.

text.text: Run your clinic from one page. Start with Referrals to contact today, check Visits for today's schedule, and watch Plans of care for visits left and recertification dates. Operational tracking only; clinical notes stay in your clinical system.
Fast, friendly follow-up is how referring offices decide to send more patients.
Log the referral and set Contact by to the next business day.
Call the patient; offer two evaluation times.
Send the intake packet by email before the visit.
Try again the next day, then once more by text.
After three tries over five days, mark the referral Lost and tell the referring office.
When the evaluation is booked, mark the referral Scheduled and start a plan of care.

pages.title: Plans of care and visit counts

text.text: Every plan has a number of authorized visits and a recertification date. Watch both.
Open the patient and press Start plan of care.
Enter visits authorized from the payer's approval.
Set Recertify by to the date the payer requires.
Open Plans of care and look at Visits left; reach out when two or fewer remain.
Plans past their recertification date are listed under Overdue.
Press Discharge when the goal is met or the patient stops coming.
Review today's Visits and confirm arrivals
Look at the Overdue list under Plans of care
Check patients in as they arrive
Mark no-shows and call them the same day
Mark every visit completed or missed
Book the next visit before each patient leaves
Missed visits cost the patient progress and the clinic revenue.
Call within the hour and offer the next opening.
Note the reason on the plan.
Two missed visits in a row, tell the primary therapist.
Three in a month, ask about a different time of day or a hold.
Each month, count no-shows from the Visits status chart and discuss at the team meeting.
